name: Franklin County, IL
findings: Franklin County has 99 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Franklin County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Franklin County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
